en.title: Resident Evil Movie Officially Becomes Zach Cregger's Biggest Hit
en.summary: The latest Resident Evil film is soaring past previous box office milestones, cementing its place as director Zach Cregger's most successful movie to date. This commercial triumph arrives as the franchise continues its global appeal.
en.body:
The cinematic universe of **Resident Evil** is once again proving its global draw, with the latest film adaptation officially set to become director **Zach Cregger**'s highest-grossing movie ever. As of this week, the film has surpassed the $270 million worldwide gross of Cregger's previous commercial success, **Weapons**, and is projected to climb even higher.

The significant boost in revenue comes courtesy of a strong opening in China, where the film debuted on October 5th and is expected to pull in approximately $35 million within its first week. This influx is projected to push the film's global total beyond $280 million. This international performance echoes the success of previous **Resident Evil** films, particularly **The Final Chapter** (2016), which earned a staggering $159.5 million in China alone, representing over half of its worldwide gross.

## A New Box Office Record for Cregger

This latest **Resident Evil** installment marks a significant career milestone for **Zach Cregger**. His earlier directorial efforts, while critically acclaimed, had not reached these financial heights. His 2022 horror hit **Barbarian** grossed $46 million worldwide, and his debut feature, **Miss March**, earned $4.6 million. The current **Resident Evil** film's performance not only solidifies Cregger's commercial viability but also places it firmly within the top ranks of video game movie adaptations, set to overtake **Tomb Raider** (2018) at $274.6 million if it reaches its $280 million target.

## What This Means for the Franchise and Fans

While **Resident Evil** is enjoying considerable commercial success and positive critical reception, the question of a sequel looms. **Zach Cregger** himself has expressed a desire to move on from franchise filmmaking, despite having ideas for future stories within the **Resident Evil** universe. This stance leaves fans in an interesting position, eager for more while acknowledging the director's creative direction. The success of this film, however, might present a compelling case for continued investment in the cinematic **Resident Evil** franchise, potentially with new creative teams at the helm.

## What's Next

**Zach Cregger**'s next project is an original deep-space sci-fi movie titled **The Flood**, slated to star Jennifer Lawrence. While this signals a shift away from established IPs for the director, the **Resident Evil** franchise's continued box office power suggests that further cinematic adventures are likely, though details remain unannounced.

content_raw: Zach Cregger has another hit on his hands with Resident Evil, and it's set to become his biggest movie ever by revenue at the box office. According to Deadline , Resident Evil is expected to surpass his current biggest movie, Weapons ($270 million worldwide), by the end of this week or sooner. It currently stands at $247.6 million worldwide. What's propelling Resident Evil higher was its release in China this week--it debuted there on October 5, and it's expected to make $35 million in China for its first week. If this comes to fruition, Resident Evil should pass $280 million globally this week. The previous Resident Evil movies from director Paul W.S. Anderson also performed phenomenally in China. The last one, 2016's The Final Chapter, made $159.5 million in China alone, making up more than 51% of the movie's worldwide gross of $312.2 million. It's the highest-grossing Resident Evil movie ever. Cregger's Resident Evil still has work to do to catch up. Cregger's earlier movie, 2022's Barbarian, made $46 million worldwide. Long before that, Cregger made Miss March, and it earned $4.6 million worldwide. In terms of all video game movies, Resident Evil ranks No. 17 , but if it does indeed reach $280 million, it will pass 2018's Tomb Raider ($274.6 million worldwide). Resident Evil is doing great commercially and scored solid reviews from critics, so people might expect a sequel. That could happen, but Cregger has said he's finished with franchise movies , even though he does have ideas for more stories . Cregger's next movie is The Flood, a deep-space sci-fi movie starring Jennifer Lawrence. It has nothing to do with Halo , despite bearing a name with ties to Halo .
